Frequently Asked Questions

How many diapers will I change a day?
In the first couple of months, you may find yourself changing diapers up to 10 times in 24 hours. Diapers should be changed whenever they are wet or soiled. Your baby will often (but not always) let you know. With a super-absorbent diaper like Pampers, you can tell if it's wet by feeling for lumps in the absorbent material.

Here are some common times for changing diapers:

  • Right before or right after every feeding
  • After every bowel movement
  • Before bedtime
  • When your baby wakes up
  • When you go out with your baby

Is there anything special I need to know about changing a diaper?
Pampers Diapers are designed to adjust to your baby's shape for a snug, comfortable fit. While you’re changing diapers, there's no need to fold the waistband in or out or to adjust the leg cuffs.

  • Place tabs parallel to the waistband and centered on the character strip.
  • Use the characters as guides to ensure the fasteners are evenly spaced.
  • Keep baby products such as powder away from the fasteners so they maintain their stickiness.

What size diaper is right for my baby?
Just like you, babies like to wear things that fit just right. Choose a size that does not sag or gap, even as your baby crawls and plays. This will help prevent leaks. Each product description on this site gives guidelines that represent the average weight for a particular size. And remember, when you move up a size, you gain absorbency.

What’s the best method to weigh my baby?
The easiest way to weigh your baby is to first hop on the scale yourself. See how much you weigh, then see how much you weigh when you hold your baby. If you subtract your weight, you'll know how much your baby weighs.

Is there any safety information I need to know about diapers?
You buy the latest toys, and babies wind up playing with silly things—like diapers. It's important to keep diapers where they should be, on your baby's bottom. Don't let your baby put the diaper in his mouth. Discard any diaper that has become torn or unsealed, and read the warning label on all bags.

How do diapers absorb all that moisture?
AGM is the absorbent gelling material widely used in diaper padding to absorb wetness. It is perfectly normal to see some gel on the skin from time to time, especially if the diaper is heavily saturated. It can easily be removed by wiping your baby's skin.

This material has a long history of safe use in a variety of products and has been in diapers for more than a decade. Absorbent gelling material is closely related to ingredients widely used in cosmetics and in food processing.

Do unused diapers need to be stored anywhere special?
Store your diapers in an area protected from extreme heat and humidity and away from products with fragrances. We recommend the diapers be kept in a dry storage area where the temperature is 85 degrees or less.

Tranquility Slimline original adult disposable briefs (also called adult disposable diapers) conform to the body for a comfortable fit while providing superior absorbency. The soft, cloth-like inside layer is gentle against your skin. The underlying, high-capacity, absorbent peach core contains superabsorbent polymers that guarantee skin dryness, odor reduction, urine pH neutralization, and inhibition of bacterial growth. Kufguards (inner leg cuffs) channel fluids into the core, helping to contain high volume urge episodes and bowel incontinence (or fecal incontinence). the Junior, X-Small and small disposable briefs feature a cloth-like backing and micro-hook closure tabs with finger lift tips that grip the soft cloth securely but still allow for multiple openings of the brief. Available in six sizes (Junior, X-Small, small, medium, large, and X-Large). latex-free.

Tranquility Slimline originales calzoncillos desechables para adultos (también llamados pañales desechables para adultos) se ajustan al cuerpo para un ajuste cómodo mientras que proporciona una absorción superior. La capa interior suave y similar al paño es suave contra tu piel. El núcleo de melocotón absorbente de alta capacidad subyacente contiene polímeros superabsorbentes que garantizan la sequedad de la piel, la reducción de olores, la neutralización del pH de la orina y la inhibición del crecimiento bacteriano. El indicador de humedad pasa de amarillo a azul cuando hay humedad, eliminando así cambios innecesarios y reduciendo costos. Kufguard (puños internos de las piernas) canalizan los fluidos en el núcleo, ayudando a contener episodios de impulso de alto volumen e incontinencia intestinal (o incontinencia fecal). Los calzoncillos desechables Junior, X-Small y pequeños cuentan con un respaldo similar a un paño y pestañas de cierre de micro-gancho con puntas de elevación de dedos que sujetan el paño suave de forma segura pero permiten múltiples aberturas del breve. Los calzoncillos desechables medianos, grandes y extragrandes tienen respaldo de plástico con pestañas de cinta reabrochables que también permiten múltiples aberturas del calzoncillos. Disponible en seis tamaños (Junior, X-Small, pequeño, mediano, grande y extragrande). Sin látex.

Signs for Knowing When to Size Up on Diapers:

1. Frequent leaks or blowouts One of the most obvious signs of a too-small diaper is when your little one is constantly leaking through diapers or having "blow outs."While parents may sometimes jump to the conclusion that the problem lies with the brand of diaper they're using, but in reality a diaper that is too small won't be able to contain your little ones messes, no matter what brand it is. Try sizing up and see if that eliminates the problem.

2. Read the box This may seem obvious, but if your child is approaching the upper limit of the diaper's weight range (i.e., you have a 16-pound baby in 12- to 18-pound size diapers) it may be time to consider a switch. The weight limits are based on average-sized babies, but not all babies are shaped the same.

3. Red marks If your baby has red marks along their thighs, that's a telltale sign that the diapers are too snug. The elastic around the leg should have some stretch, but if the diaper is too small, it won't fit properly and will create these red marks. This is definitely a time to move up a size in diapers.

4. Check the waist If you're having difficulty connecting the diaper tabs at your baby's waist, that could be a sign that it's time to move up a size. A diaper should close easily without having to tug and pull at them. Also,consider the rise of the diaper. A properly fitting diaper should come just slightly below your little one's belly button. If it's fitting a little more like a low rise, it's time to move on up.

Why would I need to order the dog diaper liners?
The dog diaper liners are recommended for dogs over 55 lbs. or for dogs that are evacuating their entire bladder.  If you have a dog in heat, the dog diaper liners are not typically required.

Will these dog diapers hold feces?
These dog diapers are primarily designed to hold urine, but depending on your dog's anatomy they might even hold feces.  If you are looking for a diaper that holds feces, we recommend using a disposable dog diaper underneath our washable diaper.

The thicker the better.
Cotton. Soft. Fluffy. Tushies unique cotton blend padding is thicker, softer and incredibly absorbent, providing your baby with cottony-soft, extra-thick Gel-Free protection. See for yourself.
Open the padding of a Tushies Diaper and you'll find nothing but a natural blend cotton and wood-pulp fluff. Powder-Free. Open the padding of the leading disposables and you can shake out a fine white powder. These are acrylic acid polymer salts. Put the powder in water and watch it turn into gel.

Nuestros pañales más conscientes de la tierra cuentan con un indicador de humedad, una mejor absorción y protección contra el soplado, comodidad similar a la nube y características únicas para cada etapa del bebé, todo mientras usa menos material y ayuda a ahorrar más de 7000 árboles cada año. Además, un ajuste seguro y cómodo para menos hundimiento + más swag. Detalles: Nuestros pañales conscientes limpios fueron diseñados conscientemente con características para cada etapa del viaje de pañales de su bebé. ¡Crece con Honesto! ¿Qué hace un pañal consciente limpio? Para hacer el núcleo del pañal, cosechamos madera de pino y abeto gestionados de forma sostenible en Escandinavia, que luego se convierte en pulpa de pelusa en un molino sueco utilizando procesamiento totalmente libre de cloro, también conocido como no dioxinas (productos químicos tóxicos) en nuestra vía fluvial. No agregamos látex, fragancia o parabenos. Utilizamos una hoja posterior 100% a base de plantas, y nuestro nuevo diseño más eficiente reduce el cantidad de material utilizado en Cada pañal Nuestros pañales son libres de crueldad y nunca probados en animales. Nuestras cajas de pañales están hechas de cartón 100% de PCR para consumo reciclado (también conocido como son 100% reciclables), lo que significa que no hay nuevos árboles cortados y no vertedero, si se reciclan Cómo usar: Acuéstese a su bebé sobre su espalda sobre una superficie segura y limpia y levante suavemente para colocar el pañal debajo de su vago. Lleva el pañal hacia arriba + hasta la barriga de tu bebé y sujeta las pestañas de forma segura. Para minimizar las fugas, asegúrese de que los puños de las piernas se retiran y no se metieron. Nuestros nuevos pañales conscientes están hechos con las mismas medidas que nuestros pañales de generación anterior. Pero debido a la apariencia menos voluminosa, es posible que desee reducir el tamaño. También asegúrese de sujetar firmemente. Los lados elásticos en los tamaños 3-6 son muy flexibles, así que asegúrate de que se sientan apretados en el vientre de tu bebé. Precaución: para evitar la asfixia, mantenga este embalaje alejado de bebés y niños. La asfixia puede resultar de cualquier cosa que los bebés se pongan en la boca. Para evitar el riesgo de asfixia, no permita que los bebés rompan el pañal. Deseche cualquier pañal roto o dañado. Como cualquier prenda de vestir, los pañales son inflamables.

החיתולים המודעים ביותר לכדור הארץ שלנו עדיין כוללים מחוון רטיבות, הגנה טובה יותר מפני ספיגה והתנפצות, נוחות דמוית ענן ותכונות ייחודיות לכל שלב בייב - הכל תוך שימוש בפחות חומר ועוזר לחסוך מעל 7000 עצים בכל שנה. בנוסף, התאמה בטוחה ונוחה עבור פחות שקיעה + יותר סווינג. פרטים: החיתולים Clean Conscious שלנו עוצבו בקפידה עם תכונות לכל שלב במסע החיתולים של התינוק שלכם. גדלו בכנות! מה גורם לחיתול נקי המודע? כדי ליצור את הליבה של החיתול, אנו קוצרים עץ מאורן מנוהל באופן בר קיימא + עצי אשוחית בסקנדינביה, אשר הופך לאחר מכן לעיסת מוך בטחנה שוודית באמצעות עיבוד ללא כלור לחלוטין – הידוע גם כללא דיוקסינים (כימיקלים רעילים) בנתיב המים שלנו אנחנו לא מוסיפים לטקס, ניחוח או פרבנים אנו משתמשים בגיליון אחורי 100% מבוסס צמחי, והחדש שלנו, עיצוב יעיל יותר מפחית את כמות החומר המשמש בכל חיתול. החיתולים שלנו הם נטולי אכזריות ומעולם לא נבדקו על בעלי חיים. קופסאות החיתולים שלנו עשויות מ-100% קרטון ממוחזר ממוחזר (הידוע גם כ-100% ממוחזר) – זה אומר שאין עצים חדשים שנחתכו ולא מזבלת, אם ממוחזר כיצד להשתמש: שכבו על הגב שלהם על משטח בטוח ונקי והרמו אותם בעדינות כדי להניח את החיתול מתחת בטלן. הביאו את החיתול הקדמי מעל + עד הבטן של התינוק שלכם והדקו את הלשוניות בצורה מאובטחת. כדי למזער דליפות, ודא שחפתי הרגליים נשלפים החוצה, ולא תחובים פנימה. החיתולים המודעים הנקיים החדשים שלנו מיוצרים באותן מידות כמו החיתולים מהדור הקודם שלנו. אבל בשל המראה הפחות מגושם, אולי תרצה מידה קטנה יותר. כמו כן הקפידו להדק בחוזקה. הצדדים הנמתחים במידות 3-6 גמישים מאוד, לכן וודאו שהם יושבים היטב על הבטן של התינוק שלכם. אזהרה: כדי למנוע חנק, יש להרחיק את האריזה הזו מתינוקות וילדים. חנק עשוי לנבוע מכל דבר שתינוקות מכניסים לפה שלהם. כדי למנוע את הסיכון לחנק, אל תאפשרו לתינוקות לקרוע את החיתול. זרקו כל חיתולים קרועים או פגומים. כמו כל פריט לבוש, חיתולים דליקים.

Unsere erdbewussten Windeln verfügen über einen Nässeindikator, eine bessere Absorption und Ausblasschutz, wolkenähnlicher Komfort und einzigartige Eigenschaften für jede Babe-Phase – und das alles bei weniger Material und helfen, jedes Jahr über 7000 Bäume zu retten. Plus, eine sichere, bequeme Passform für weniger Durchhängen und mehr Girlanden. Details: Unsere Clean Conscious Windeln wurden sorgfältig mit Funktionen für jede Phase der Windelreise Ihres Babys entworfen. Mit Ehrlichkeit aufwachsen! Was macht eine saubere, bewusste Windel aus? Um den Kern der Windel herzustellen, ernten wir Holz aus nachhaltig bewirtschafteten Kiefer + Fichtenbäumen in Skandinavien, die dann in einer schwedischen Mühle mit einer völlig chlorfreien Verarbeitung in Flaumstoff umgewandelt werden – aka keine Dioxine (giftige Chemikalien) in unserem Wasserbahn. Wir fügen kein Latex, Duft oder Parabene hinzu. Wir verwenden eine 100% pflanzliche Rückwand, und unser neues, effizienteres Design reduziert die Menge des verwendeten Materials Unsere Windeln sind tierversuchsfrei und nie an Tieren getestet. Unsere Windelboxen sind aus 100 % PCR-Post-Recycling-Karton (aka, sie sind 100 % recycelbar) – das bedeutet, dass keine neuen Bäume abgeschnitten werden und keine Deponie entstehen, wenn sie recycelt werden. Anwendung: Legen Sie Ihr Baby auf einen sicheren, sauberen Untergrund und heben Sie sie sanft unter die Windel zu legen. um. Bringen Sie die Windel vorne über + bis zum Bauch Ihres Babys und befestigen Sie die Laschen sicher. Um Auslaufen zu minimieren, stellen Sie sicher, dass die Beinbündchen herausgezogen und nicht eingesteckt sind. Unsere neuen sauber bewussten Windeln werden mit den gleichen Maßen wie unsere Windeln der vorherigen Generation hergestellt. Aber aufgrund des weniger sperrigen Aussehens möchten Sie vielleicht eine Größe kleiner machen. Achten Sie auch darauf, fest zu befestigen. Die dehnbaren Seiten bei den Größen 3-6 sind sehr flexibel, stellen Sie sicher, dass sie eng am Bauch Ihres Babys sitzen. Achtung: Um Erstickungsgefahr zu vermeiden, halten Sie diese Verpackung von Babys und Kindern fern. Ersticken kann durch alles resultieren, was Babys in den Mund nehmen. Um die Gefahr des Erstickens zu vermeiden, lassen Sie Babys die Windel nicht reißen. Entsorgen Sie zerrissene oder beschädigte Windeln. Wie jedes Kleidungsstück sind Windeln entflammbar.

O que torna uma fralda limpa e consciente? Won’t Swell Up in Water
Regular diapers swell up when they get wet. Splashers don’t, so your baby can splash happy.


In the first couple of months, you may find yourself changing diapers up to 10 times in 24 hours. Diapers should be changed whenever they are wet or soiled. Your baby will often (but not always) let you know. With a super-absorbent diaper like Pampers, you can tell if it's wet by feeling for lumps in the absorbent material.

Here are some common times for changing diapers:

  • Right before or right after every feeding
  • After every bowel movement
  • Before bedtime
  • When your baby wakes up
  • When you go out with your baby

Is there anything special I need to know about changing a diaper?
Pampers Diapers are designed to adjust to your baby's shape for a snug, comfortable fit. While you’re changing diapers, there's no need to fold the waistband in or out or to adjust the leg cuffs.

  • Place tabs parallel to the waistband and centered on the character strip.
  • Use the characters as guides to ensure the fasteners are evenly spaced.
  • Keep baby products such as powder away from the fasteners so they maintain their stickiness.

What size diaper is right for my baby?
Just like you, babies like to wear things that fit just right. Choose a size that does not sag or gap, even as your baby crawls and plays. This will help prevent leaks. Each product description on this site gives guidelines that represent the average weight for a particular size. And remember, when you move up a size, you gain absorbency.

What’s the best method to weigh my baby?
The easiest way to weigh your baby is to first hop on the scale yourself. See how much you weigh, then see how much you weigh when you hold your baby. If you subtract your weight, you'll know how much your baby weighs.

Is there any safety information I need to know about diapers?
You buy the latest toys, and babies wind up playing with silly things—like diapers. It's important to keep diapers where they should be, on your baby's bottom. Don't let your baby put the diaper in his mouth. Discard any diaper that has become torn or unsealed, and read the warning label on all bags.

How do diapers absorb all that moisture?
AGM is the absorbent gelling material widely used in diaper padding to absorb wetness. It is perfectly normal to see some gel on the skin from time to time, especially if the diaper is heavily saturated. It can easily be removed by wiping your baby's skin.

This material has a long history of safe use in a variety of products and has been in diapers for more than a decade. Absorbent gelling material is closely related to ingredients widely used in cosmetics and in food processing.

Do unused diapers need to be stored anywhere special?
Store your diapers in an area protected from extreme heat and humidity and away from products with fragrances. We recommend the diapers be kept in a dry storage area where the temperature is 85 degrees or less.
